BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

3. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   D. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

5. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

6. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   C. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.

7. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

8. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   B. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   C. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.

12. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   B. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Procurement as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   D. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

16. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   B. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The Ledger and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Trial Balance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
